title: 蚯蚓在土里做什么
subtitle: 地下的小小农夫
character: wearing a green t-shirt, brown shorts and rubber boots, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, earthy gouache painting on textured paper, flat simple rounded shapes with clean outlines, warm soil brown, moss green and soft cream palette, visible brush texture

pages.zh:
下过雨以后，
我在院子里看见一条「蚯蚓」。
它粉粉的，软软的，
一伸一缩地爬。
它平时住在哪里呢？
pages.scene: The little boy crouches on wet ground in rubber boots, looking closely at a worm on the soil, hands on his knees.

pages.zh:
蚯蚓住在土里。
它没有眼睛，
也没有脚，
可是它能感觉到光和震动，
知道上面有没有危险。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one worm on a brown background shown from the side, its body divided into many small segments, with no eyes and no legs. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它靠身上一圈一圈的肌肉爬。
先把前面伸长，
再把后面缩上来。
身上还有小刚毛，
像很多只小脚一样抓住土。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one worm on a brown background shown in three stages left to right: stretched forward, middle pulled up, then stretched again. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
蚯蚓一边爬，
一边吃土。
土里有烂掉的叶子和小虫子，
那才是它要的食物。
吃不完的，就从后面排出去。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one worm in a soil cross-section on a brown background with soil entering at its mouth end and small round castings leaving at its tail end. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它排出来的那些小土粒，
叫蚯蚓粪。
它比原来的土
更松、更有营养，
植物最喜欢。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: a small pile of rounded worm castings on the soil surface on a brown background, with one young plant growing beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它钻来钻去，
在土里留下很多小通道。
空气顺着通道进去，
雨水也顺着流下去，
土就不会板结。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one soil cross-section on a brown background with several winding tunnels through it, small arrows showing air and water going down the tunnels. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以有蚯蚓的地里，
庄稼长得更好。
很久以前的人就说，
蚯蚓是地下的农夫，
一直在替我们松土。
pages.scene: A soil cross-section on a brown background: healthy green plants with long roots above, several worms and tunnels below. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
蚯蚓没有肺。
它用皮肤呼吸，
所以皮肤要一直是湿的。
太阳一晒，皮肤干了，
它就没法呼吸了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one worm on a brown background with small arrows pointing into its skin all along its body. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
下大雨的时候，
土里灌满了水，
空气被挤走了。
蚯蚓喘不过气，
只好爬到地面上来。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one soil cross-section on a brown background filled with water in the tunnels, and two worms coming up onto the surface. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以雨后的路上，
常常能看见蚯蚓。
要是太阳出来了，
它们就回不去，
会被晒干。
pages.scene: A wet path on a cream background after rain with two worms on it, a puddle nearby and the sun beginning to come out. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
看见它们，
可以用小树枝
轻轻把它们送回泥土里。
别用手捏太紧，
它们很软，很容易受伤。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one small twig gently lifting a worm from a path on a cream background toward a patch of dark soil beside it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我用小铲子挖了个小坑，
把那条蚯蚓放回土里。
它扭了两下，
钻下去不见了。
院子里的土，就交给它了。
pages.scene: The little boy kneels on the ground using a small trowel to place a worm gently into a hole in the soil, watching it go.
